headword: {舞台|ぶたい}{恐怖症|きょうふしょう}
reading: ぶたいきょうふしょう

definitions.explanation: Intense fear or anxiety about performing or speaking in front of an audience. Can range from mild nervousness to a debilitating phobia.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{舞台|ぶたい}{恐怖症|きょうふしょう}だ。
{舞台|ぶたい}{恐怖症|きょうふしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{克服|こくふく}する→克服する：15863_kokufukusuru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{重|かさ}ねた→重ねる：02039_kasaneru⟧。
examples.english: I practiced extensively to overcome my stage fright.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{舞台|ぶたい}{恐怖症|きょうふしょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{人前|ひとまえ}→人前：19380_hitomae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{苦手|にがて}→苦手：03513_nigate⟧だった。
examples.english: I've had stage fright since childhood and have always struggled with speaking in front of people.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{舞台|ぶたい}→舞台：03606_butai⟧ (stage) and ⟦{恐怖症|きょうふしょう}→恐怖症：27678_kyoufushou⟧ (phobia). While the literal meaning refers to stages, it applies broadly to any situation involving performing or presenting in front of others.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {舞台|ぶたい}{恐怖症|きょうふしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{克服|こくふく}する→克服する：15863_kokufukusuru⟧: to overcome stage fright
- {舞台|ぶたい}{恐怖症|きょうふしょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{悩|なや}む→悩む：02380_nayamu⟧: to suffer from stage fright
- ⟦{軽|かる}い→軽い：00785_karui⟧{舞台|ぶたい}{恐怖症|きょうふしょう}: mild stage fright

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦あがり{症|しょう}→あがり症：21562_agarishou⟧: tendency to get nervous — more colloquial and broader than stage-specific fear
- ⟦{対人|たいじん}→対人：28357_taijin⟧⟦{恐怖症|きょうふしょう}→恐怖症：27678_kyoufushou⟧: social phobia — fear of social interaction in general, not limited to performance
- ⟦{緊張|きんちょう}→緊張：02494_kinchou⟧: nervousness — a milder, more general term for being tense
